Nora (Support): @Devon following up on ticket #7892 — you mentioned function-calling responses started breaking after today's model refresh. Still happening? Can you paste the failing request + response (redact sensitive fields).

Devon (Customer): Yep, started right after the morning auto-update. We call the API with our order function and now see 400 + 'schema validation failed'. Minimal request below (sanitized):

```json
{
  "model": "redwood-chat-large-aurora",
  "messages": [{"role":"user","content":"Buy 2x SKU: RED-77"}],
  "functions": [{"name":"create_order","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"order_id":{"type":"string"},"items":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"}}}}}],
  "function_call": "auto"
}
```

Response body (HTTP 400):

```json
{
  "error": "schema validation failed",
  "detail": {"tool_call": {"name": "create_order", "arguments": "{\n    order_id: 42,\n    items: [\\\"RED-77\\\"]\n  }"}}
}
```

Note: arguments is a plain-text block, not JSON. Previously it was a JSON object.

Ravi (Eng-ML): Thanks Devon, that matches what we saw in canary logs. We rolled v3.0.1 of redwood-chat-large-aurora at 08:30 UTC to default; canary suggested it would be fine but the model started emitting text-formatted arguments occasionally.

deploy-bot: rollout summary:

```
[deploy-bot] canary/redwood-chat-large-aurora v3.0.1 -> 5% -> 100% scheduled 08:30 UTC
```

Sam (Oncall): Is this limited to certain prompts or universal? Any correlation with sequence length or system message?

Devon (Customer): Happens consistently for our payment/order flows. Pinning to `redwood-chat-large-aurora@2026-02-28` returns object arguments as expected. Current default snapshot `@2026-03-11` returns text blobs.

Ravi (Eng-ML): Repro confirmed by Eng-ML: pinned snapshot works; latest snapshot reproduces the text-blob arguments. Hypothesis: a small change in function-calling decoding increases preference for text output in borderline cases. This is model-behavioral, not runtime serialization.

Priya (Product): This is customer-impacting and affects non-pinned users. We need to: A) revert default catalog to previous snapshot; B) notify customers and recommend pinning; C) plan a fix. Preference: immediate revert + short-lived runtime fallback to coerce text->JSON for common patterns while Eng-ML fixes the model. Thoughts?

Sam (Oncall): Revert is low-risk and quick. Runtime coercion could help but might mask the root problem and could mis-parse ambiguous text. I recommend revert first, then a targeted shim with heavy logging.

Nora (Support): Devon — we can immediately pin your org to the older snapshot to unblock. Do you want us to apply that now?

Devon (Customer): Please do, thanks. We'll also temporarily set explicit `function_call` to the function name as another workaround (forces structured?).

deploy-bot: catalog action:

```
[deploy-bot] catalog/redwood-chat-large-aurora default -> pinned to @2026-02-28 at 09:15 UTC by ops/rollback-job
```

Ravi (Eng-ML): I'll open ENG-ML-498. Short term: I'll prototype a conservative parser shim at the runtime layer that checks if `tool_call.arguments` is a string; if so, try JSON.parse first, then a quasi-URL-decode & JSON fallback, then a heuristic key:value parser. All attempts will log raw payload and parsing path to diagnostics. We'll canary that on a tiny subset of traffic and surface metrics (parse success rate, errors).

Priya (Product): Set a communication on status.redwood: note a regression in function-calling for redwood-chat-large-aurora, default reverted, mitigation steps (pin, explicit function_call, temporary parsing shim being tested). Notify enterprise CS.

Nora (Support): Adding KB entries: repro snippet, recommended pins, SDK snippet to set `function_call: 'create_order'`, and how to pin via console/API.

Devon (Customer): Confirmed pinned and tests pass. Thanks for quick help.

Sam (Oncall): Filing follow-up incident: INC-2026-0313 	6 - Function-calling serialization regression after model snapshot update. Assign ENG-ML-498 to Ravi. ETA 72h for model fix or revert-and-retrain.

Ravi (Eng-ML): PR for parser shim + tests: https://git.company/repo/pull/1302. Will canary on 1% runtime traffic after approvals. If shim success rate >= 99% and low false-positives, we'll keep it until model artifact is patched.

Nora (Support): Devon, closing the support escalation. We'll reach out if the shim canary changes behavior or if we need sample logs from you. Reopen anytime. :thumbsup:

Devon (Customer): All clear for now, appreciate the fast rollback and pin. :raised_hands:

deploy-bot: incident update:

```
[deploy-bot] incident/INC-2026-0313: default catalog reverted for redwood-chat-large-aurora; runtime parser shim in review; monitoring set for 3h.
```

Priya (Product): Postmortem requested in ENG-ML-498. Please include canary metrics and decision rationale for shim vs model patch.

Ravi (Eng-ML): Will include unit/integration tests and a comparison of canary parsing outcomes. Will also add an internal diagnostic toggle to enable detailed logs for customers who opt-in.

Nora (Support): Resolving thread; will publish KB and status updates.

Ravi (Eng-ML): Leaving the thread; will update ticket with root cause and PR link after canary results.
